articles.title: The U.S. is maxing out its strategic oil reserves as Trump vows to control the Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: Strategic Petroleum Reserve stockpiles are precariously low and have been hit by major equipment failures, leaks and spills, according to a government report.

articles.title: Trump reinstates Iran port blockade and vows 20% charge on cargo passing through Hormuz
articles.description: The US president also says Washington will impose a 20% charge on all cargo shipped through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Iran military warns US against Strait of Hormuz ‘interference’
articles.description: Iran's military has warned it will not allow the United States to ‘interfere’ in the management of the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Micron and other chip stocks feel the pain of imported volatility — blame SK Hynix
articles.description: The SOX chip index was suffering a unanimous selloff, after SK Hynix’s stock had its worst day in 18 years in South Korea trading.

articles.title: US keeping the Strait of Hormuz open is ‘a massive force problem’
articles.description: Former NATO analyst says Trump's push for a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz would mean a huge military operation.

articles.title: SpaceX stock sinks for a second-straight day, nearing $135 IPO price
articles.description: SpaceX went public a month ago in a record IPO. Elon Musk's space and AI company was added to the Nasdaq-100 last week.

articles.title: Trump proposes 20% toll on cargo through Strait of Hormuz; restarts Iran blockade
articles.description: The Strait of Hormuz is a major oil shipping route and the epicenter of the U.S. and Israel's ongoing war with Iran.

articles.title: UK arrests 12 over extreme right-wing ‘terror’ threat to Muslim event

articles.title: Man wanted in connection with murder arrested in Jordan

articles.title: Global oil prices top $83 a barrel, logging biggest jump in 6 years after Trump reimposes Strait of Hormuz blockade

articles.title: A July rate hike from the Fed? The odds are rising
